rows.en: ...Then, Altair, you intend to search for the Data Weapons alone?
That's right. I have no need of your help to carry out His Majesty's orders.
But then...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing objection.

rows.en: The authority you've been granted does not extend to restricting my movements. So I will do as I please.
You can carry out your own operation to wipe out humanity on Earth. Earn yourselves all the glory you can...
Grr...
Well, well. Even Oyakata-sama seems to lose all dignity in front of the captain of the Royal Guard.
rows.notes: Mocking title and Royal Guard captain; Oyakata-sama is fixed glossary title.

rows.en: You speak out of turn, Diondra.
Do I? Then perhaps I won't tell you my secret plan.
A secret plan...?
That's right. A plan to get our hands on Dendoh... and the Data Weapons.
Then let us hear it, shall we?
It'll cost you, you know?
If you succeed, I will inform His Majesty the Emperor of your achievements.
Then the news will reach Gades as well...
rows.notes: Sentence leads into row15; trailing source ellipsis retained.

rows.en: And that Commander Ranking of yours will surely rise.
Hmph... I'll just listen and leave it at that.
rows.notes: Diondra silently distrusts the promised reward; literal hear-only phrasing retained.
uncertain: Cynical hear-only thought could imply she will not trust the promised reward; literal wording retained.

rows.en: So, what is your plan?
That Dendoh runs on electricity, doesn't it?
It does.
rows.notes: Stray closing Japanese wrapper ignored per brief.

rows.en: Then we just cut it off at the source. Do that, and it won't be able to move.
Hmph. And here I was wondering what sort of plan you had...
rows.notes: Deliberately trailing disdain before Gourmet elaborates.

rows.en: We thought of the same thing long ago.
Then why haven't you put it into action?
The Chips' reports revealed that the humans have solved that problem.
Yes... by exchanging its batteries during battle...
rows.notes: Battery workaround responds to row24; deliberately trailing ellipsis retained.

rows.en: Ha! For someone with such a huge body, you certainly think small.
What do you mean...?
rows.notes: Stray closing Japanese wrapper ignored per brief.

rows.en: I told you, didn't I? Cut it off at the source.
In other words, we get rid of all the electricity in that whole area they call Japan, where they're based.
Ahhh... That was a great bath.
Yeah. The one on the Nahel Argama sure isn't that big.
That's GEAR HQ for you. That amusement park overhead isn't just for show. I never thought even the baths would be so great.
They've got rock baths, electric baths, open-air baths... You name it.
rows.notes: Electric bath is a real bath type here, not a claim the whole facility is electric.

rows.en: That place beats your average hot spring hands down.
Oh? Kaine, are you boys out already?
Yeah. Are you ladies heading in now, #女愛称?
That's right. I'm going with Ple and Roux.
Hey, hey! How was the bath?
Ple, you'll have so much to choose from, you won't know where to look.
rows.notes: Koji tells Ple she will be spoiled for bath choices.

rows.en: Really!? Ooh, I can't wait! Come on, let's go, let's go!
All right, I get it. Don't rush me so much.
Oh, right. One more thing...
rows.notes: Lead-in to threat in row43.

rows.en: If you peek, a hundred slaps won't be enough for you, you know?
W-who said we were gonna peek!?
Hey, give us a little credit!
But I can't trust you.
We're not Tapp... Just go on in already.
Okay! Ple-ple-ple-pleee!!
rows.notes: Ple name-chant kept as repeated localized name.

rows.en: Ah, Ple! Don't run! You'll hurt yourself!
...Kaine, my good sir.
rows.notes: Mock courtesy begins Koji and Kaine secret peeping exchange.

rows.en: Koji, my good sir.
rows.notes: Mock courtesy matches row50.

rows.en: Shall we go?
rows.notes: Koji invites Kaine to go peeking; restrained mock-formal invitation.

rows.en: Shall we, indeed?
rows.notes: Kaine echoes mock-formal invitation.

rows.en: As men, if we let this chance slip by...
rows.notes: Conditional continues into row55, preserving deliberate row break.

rows.en: We're sure to regret it for the rest of our lives.
rows.notes: Completes row54 conditional with settled joint subject.

rows.en: If we're afraid of a few slaps...
rows.notes: Conditional continues into row57, preserving deliberate row break.

rows.en: How are we supposed to fight Giganos!?
rows.notes: Completes row56; defiant spoken rhetoric. Final removes added profanity; forceful rhetoric remains.

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'. The line is reused in i00r0a:3/16/62/97 (the interlude), so it is a neutral silence.

rows.en: Oh, #男愛称...
rows.notes: Addresses male lead after original58 reused silence.

rows.en: Did you happen to hear that just now?
What are you talking about?
N-no... Nothing.
rows.notes: Hesitant denial; deliberate short reply.

rows.en: By the way, #男愛称, have you had a bath yet?
No... I can wait until everyone else is done.
rows.notes: Male lead postpones his own bath until the others finish.

rows.en: Don't tell me you hate baths?
rows.notes: Stray closing Japanese wrapper ignored per brief.

rows.en: It's not that.
Anyway, Lt. Douglas said he was going to gather everyone in B Team for a meeting.
rows.notes: Meeting calls B Team including the male lead, not an instruction to Douglas.

rows.en: It's in twenty minutes... Don't be late.
Okay, got it.
And one more thing... Don't go peeking. If the lieutenant finds out, you'll be in for it.
rows.notes: Male lead warns Koji/Kaine against peeking; original69 reused acknowledgment read.

rows.en: ...So you did hear us after all.
Anyway, about that meeting... We're B Team, right?
Yeah, and so is #男愛称.
If it's in twenty minutes, he won't have much time for a bath, will he?
rows.notes: Context settles male lead as subject of lack of bath time.

rows.en: He doesn't get many chances like this. He should've just gone right in.
rows.notes: Context settles male lead as person who should already have bathed.

rows.en: Maybe he doesn't like going to the baths with everyone...
rows.notes: Deliberately trailing hypothesis; subject restored as male lead.

rows.en: Come to think of it, even after a mission, he slips off to get changed alone.
rows.notes: Male lead referenced as he; source identifies male protagonist placeholder, no name-based gender guess.

rows.en: Maybe he doesn't want other people seeing him naked?
Then he wouldn't wear a shirt with a hole over his stomach, would he?
rows.notes: Exposed abdomen contradicts modesty explanation.

rows.en: Yeah, you're right. I wonder if there's some other reason.
K-Kaine!
rows.notes: Female lead interrupts speculation; following original82-88 explains bath water/electrical outage.

rows.en: What's wrong, #女愛称?
rows.notes: Kaine addresses the female lead after her alarmed call; runtime nickname preserved.

rows.en: Wait, were you taking a bath in those clothes?
rows.notes: Koji jokes that her outfit means she bathed fully clothed.

rows.en: That's right. If anything happens, I can get to my station right away...
rows.notes: Female lead plays along sarcastically; intentional trailing explanation retained.

rows.en: Wait, no! The bath! The hot bathwater turned cold!!
rows.notes: Female lead rejects the joke and reports suddenly cold bathwater; explicit hot/cold meaning restored.

rows.en: Cold!?
rows.notes: Koji's incredulous echo is an intentional fragment.

rows.en: W-what's going on!?
rows.notes: Kaine's startled question restores what is happening.

rows.en: A-a power outage!?
rows.notes: Koji asks whether the sudden disruption is a power outage; stutter retained.

rows.en: Hey, Shinji. Is it true that EVA-02 beat an Angel in just a few dozen seconds?
rows.notes: Scene changes to Kensuke asking Shinji about EVA-02 defeating an Angel; tens of seconds retained.

rows.en: Y-you sure know a lot... about that.
rows.notes: Shinji stammers in surprise at Kensuke's knowledge.

rows.en: My dad works at NERV. I can find that sort of thing out... by looking at his computer.
rows.notes: Kensuke explains that he reads his NERV-employed father's computer; father supplies the computer referent.

rows.en: Doesn't that mean there's a problem with their security...?
rows.notes: Actual kind is thought; Shinji privately questions confidentiality/security.

rows.en: Hey, hey, what's EVA-02 like?
rows.notes: Kensuke asks Shinji what EVA-02 is like.

rows.en: It's the first mass-produced Evangelion... And it's designed for actual combat, right?
rows.notes: Kensuke describes EVA-02 as first mass-produced Evangelion and purpose-built for real combat; not a named Mass-produced EVA unit.

rows.en: Well... It's red, I guess. But it doesn't have a horn like my EVA-01.
rows.notes: Shinji hesitantly describes the color and absence of his own EVA-01's horn.

rows.en: It's mass-produced and red!? And it has no horn!? They don't get it! They just don't get it!
rows.notes: Kensuke objects to the design through a Gundam allusion; they refers to those responsible for the design, left unnamed.
uncertain: The unnamed they is inferred as the EVA designers from the design criticism; source leaves target of the rebuke unstated.

rows.en: W-why?
rows.notes: Shinji's stammered request for an explanation.

rows.en: A red one has to be rare, have a horn, and be three times faster!
rows.notes: Kensuke lists all three traits in the red-unit Gundam joke: rarity, horn, triple speed.

rows.en: I-I don't know anything about that...
rows.notes: Shinji says he does not know that convention; stutter retained.

rows.en: I don't want to admit it! I just can't! That's what you call a mistake born of youth!
rows.notes: Kensuke's repeated refusal and youth/error allusion retained without copying an existing English candidate.

rows.en: ...What the heck have you been babbling about all this time?
rows.notes: Toji interrupts Kensuke's incomprehensible rambling; colloquial rough voice.

rows.en: Oh, Toji... Have you finished visiting your sister?
rows.notes: Kensuke asks whether Toji finished his hospital visit to his sister.

rows.en: Yeah. Her condition hasn't changed, at least.
rows.notes: Toji says his sister's condition is unchanged; condition subject restored.
Intentional silence; same source row also used at battle-map uses409,587,600, all contexts checked.

rows.en: ...Shinji, you don't have to keep worrying about it.
rows.notes: Toji reassures Shinji about his sister's injury; reassurance direction retained.

rows.en: Sure, my sister got caught up in the fight between your Evangelion and the Angel, and she got hurt...
rows.notes: Toji acknowledges his sister's injury during Shinji's EVA/Angel battle; intentional trailing qualification retained.

rows.en: But I figure it couldn't be helped. So you don't need to worry about it.
rows.notes: Toji calls the injury unavoidable and tells Shinji not to blame himself; full subjects and verbs retained.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry... Toji...
rows.notes: Shinji's broken apology addresses Toji; intentional hesitation retained.

rows.en: Don't look so glum. Anyway, how about we go get some takoyaki?
rows.notes: Toji encourages Shinji and suggests takoyaki; food name preserved as ordinary cultural term.

rows.en: Wait right there! Where do you think you're going without doing the cleaning!?
rows.notes: Hikari stops them leaving without cleaning; accusatory question direction retained.

rows.en: Gah, Class Rep...!
rows.notes: Toji reacts to Hikari, the Class Rep; intentional address/exclamation fragment.

rows.en: See, Hikari? It's just like I told you, isn't it?
rows.notes: Asuka points out to Hikari that her prediction was correct.

rows.en: There's no way this Three Idiots Trio would ever take cleaning seriously.
rows.notes: Asuka disparages the boys' willingness to clean; glossary nickname retained.

rows.en: Shut up! I only just got here!
rows.notes: Toji angrily counters that he only just arrived.

rows.en: That doesn't matter! As punishment, you're cleaning tomorrow too! Got that!?
rows.notes: Asuka imposes extra cleaning tomorrow as punishment and demands acknowledgement.

rows.en: Don't be stupid! The Osaka Titans night game is on TV tomorrow, so I've gotta get home early!
rows.notes: Toji cites tomorrow's televised Osaka Titans night game as reason to go home early. Central decision approves Osaka Titans as the source-literal fictional baseball team, distinct from the Gundam military Titans; do not substitute Hanshin Tigers.
uncertain: Osaka Titans is centrally approved source-literal wording; no Akurasu or independent canonical English team entry is established.

rows.en: Titans, or those other Titans, whatever! Punishment is punishment! Don't think you can get out of it!
rows.notes: Asuka confuses baseball Titans with the Gundam Titans; English identical spelling needs a contextual distinction.
uncertain: Japanese distinguishes two Titans pronunciations; English renders the confusion as those other Titans, losing the audible vowel contrast.

rows.en: Ah... She's as harsh as ever.
rows.notes: Kensuke mutters that Asuka is as harsh as ever; subject restored from scene.

rows.en: Did you say something!?
rows.notes: Asuka challenges Kensuke's muttered criticism.

rows.en: Uh... No, nothing.
rows.notes: Kensuke backs down; intentional conversational dismissal retained.

rows.en: Hey, Kensuke... Just between you and me...
rows.notes: Shinji starts a private disclosure to Kensuke; intentional trailing setup retained.

rows.en: Asuka is EVA-02's pilot.
rows.notes: Shinji reveals that Asuka pilots EVA-02.

rows.en: Whaaat!?
rows.notes: Kensuke's drawn-out shocked exclamation.

rows.en: You two! What are you whispering about!?
rows.notes: Asuka calls out Shinji and Kensuke for whispering.

rows.en: I-it's nothing, really.
rows.notes: Shinji denies anything is happening; stutter retained.

rows.en: ...Guess we don't have a choice. Let's get the cleaning done, then.
rows.notes: Toji yields and proposes cleaning promptly.

rows.en: Suzuhara... Here, take this.
rows.notes: Hikari addresses Toji by surname and hands him a device; intentional handover fragment.

rows.en: What's this? A vacuum cleaner?
rows.notes: Toji identifies the device as a vacuum cleaner; powered cleaning context settles cleaner.

rows.en: Yes. It'll help you finish cleaning sooner, won't it?
rows.notes: Hikari explains that it will help finish cleaning sooner; device subject restored.

rows.en: Hey, Hikari! Don't spoil the three idiots! Brooms are good enough for them!
rows.notes: Asuka protests Hikari spoiling the three idiots and says brooms suffice.

rows.en: But... It's almost time to go home. Shinji, here... You take one too.
rows.notes: Hikari cites dismissal time and hands Shinji a cleaner too; intentional handover phrase retained.

rows.en: Thanks.
rows.notes: Shinji thanks Hikari; conventional standalone thanks retained.

rows.en: Hey, Class Rep. This vacuum cleaner isn't working!
rows.notes: Toji tells Hikari his vacuum does not work.

rows.en: Huh? But I've plugged the power cord in properly...
rows.notes: Hikari says she has plugged it in properly; first-person subject restored.

rows.en: Oh... Mine isn't working either.
rows.notes: Shinji reports his vacuum does not work either.

rows.en: Could it be... a power outage?
rows.notes: Asuka speculates that they have a power outage.

rows.en: It might be...
rows.notes: Shinji tentatively agrees; power outage is contextual it.

rows.en: ...Ikari.
rows.notes: Rei quietly addresses Shinji as Ikari; intentional address fragment.

rows.en: Ayanami... You're still here too?
rows.notes: Shinji asks Ayanami whether she is still at school.

rows.en: ...We've been summoned for an emergency.
rows.notes: Rei reports an emergency summons for all three pilots; plural us restored.

rows.en: What...!?
rows.notes: Shinji's startled reaction.

rows.en: Could an Angel be...!?
rows.notes: Asuka's unfinished speculation about an Angel is intentionally left trailing.

rows.en: I don't know. They haven't told me the details.
rows.notes: Rei says she has not been briefed on the details.

rows.en: For now, shouldn't we head to headquarters?
rows.notes: Shinji suggests that they go to headquarters; joint we restored.

rows.en: Right. If it's an emergency, something must have happened.
rows.notes: Asuka reasons that the emergency summons means something happened.

rows.en: Power supply in Tokyo-3, from Block A to Block F... has dropped to 8% of normal.
rows.notes: Command-room scene change; Shigeru reports Blocks A-F supply at8% of normal in Tokyo-3.

rows.en: It's not just the area above us. Other districts have lost power too.
rows.notes: Makoto reports other districts also lack power, beyond the city directly above NERV.

rows.en: Yeah... It looks like it's spreading fast.
rows.notes: Shigeru confirms that the blackout is spreading quickly.

rows.en: ...What's the situation?
rows.notes: Misato requests a situation report; full interrogative restored.

rows.en: Large-scale blackouts are occurring simultaneously, centered on the Kanto region. The cause is unknown.
rows.notes: Makoto reports simultaneous major blackouts centered on Kanto and unknown cause. Kanto region verified centrally against official JNTO: https://www.japan.travel/en/destinations/kanto/ .

rows.en: At this rate, about 30% of Japan will lose power within an hour.
rows.notes: Shigeru predicts roughly30% of Japan without power within one hour.

rows.en: We have our own generators, so we should be all right for now...
rows.notes: Misato says NERV has its own generators, so they can manage for now; intentional trailing transition retained.

rows.en: Large-scale blackouts happening in several areas at once... That just doesn't happen under normal conditions.
rows.notes: Misato states simultaneous widespread outages are abnormal; large scale and multiplicity retained.

rows.en: Could this be... an Angel's doing?
rows.notes: Misato asks whether an Angel is responsible.

rows.en: ...That possibility is extremely remote.
rows.notes: Ritsuko judges the Angel hypothesis extremely unlikely; possibility subject restored.

rows.en: Then what is it, Dr. Akagi?
rows.notes: Misato asks Ritsuko, addressed as Dr. Akagi, for the cause.

rows.en: Who knows... The bigger problem is that hacking we discussed.
rows.notes: Ritsuko is unsure of the cause and raises the previously discussed hacking as the larger problem.

rows.en: You mean... the attempts to meddle with MAGI over the last few days?
rows.notes: Misato identifies the recent days of attempts against MAGI.

rows.en: Yes, that's right. We're getting another one now.
rows.notes: Ritsuko confirms the recurring hacking is happening again now; explicit we subject restored.

rows.en: What...!?
rows.notes: Misato's shocked response.

rows.en: Firewall thawed. Simulated entry deployed. Preparations for a reverse trace are complete.
rows.notes: Maya gives technical status updates and confirms reverse-trace preparations; report-style participial fragments retained deliberately. Central decision approves firewall thawed and simulated entry deployed as literal fictional countertrace wording; no real cybersecurity mechanism or pilot entry is added.
uncertain: Firewall thawed and simulated entry deployed are centrally approved literal fictional system wording; independently established canonical technical English remains unavailable.

rows.en: Begin backtracing with Pattern C. Don't forget the decoys.
We've lost the target!
...They're quick to get away, as always.
Was there any damage?
No... The target vanished without extracting or destroying any data.
So there's no malice or hostility behind it?
Yes. We don't even know the purpose of the hacking.
Maybe they're just toying with us.
That can't be...! If it were Lieutenant Commander Ruri Hoshino, perhaps...
rows.notes: Ruri is the exceptional hacker in the comparison; source trails into row169. Stray closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: But no matter how good a hacker is, hacking the MAGI should be impossible.
Yes. The MAGI is a seventh-generation supercomputer with a personality-transplant OS.
It could be an inside job, but I have an idea who it is.
Did the MAGI come up with an answer?
Yes. With two votes in favor and one conditional vote in favor, its answer was...
rows.notes: MAGI vote result trails into the next row; both affirmative vote categories retained.

rows.en: A Data Weapon.
What did you say...!?
...Aiko, how is the power supply in each region?
It doesn't look good. On average, it's fallen to at most 10% of the normal supply.
rows.notes: Corrected below 10% to at most 10% to preserve inclusive source bound.

rows.en: And more and more areas are losing power. If this keeps up...
rows.notes: Source deliberately trails off on the consequences of continuing blackouts.

rows.en: ...Dr. Inoue, do you have any idea what's causing the blackouts?
Well... Something very strange is going on.
What do you mean?
None of the power plants in the affected areas have broken down or malfunctioned.
Then you're saying this isn't the work of humans?
Yes. It's hard to believe, but someone is somehow absorbing power from all these regions...
rows.notes: Absorption sentence continues in row185; unknown actor remains gender-neutral.

rows.en: And I believe they're storing it somewhere.
rows.notes: Restored actor from row184; completes the split absorption/storage statement.

rows.en: Absorbing and storing it...? That's absurd. We're talking about an enormous amount of power.
For that matter, with so much energy moving around, why can't we identify what's absorbing it?
rows.notes: Absorption endpoint/device, not the already-known power-supply regions.

rows.en: Yes, exactly... The mystery just keeps getting deeper.
I doubt even Gulfer could do something like this...
If this goes on much longer, we'll have no choice but to accept the Federation government's request.
Then we'll use the Hyper Dendoh Batteries...?
rows.notes: Restored proposed use of the batteries from the Federation request and row192; source trails off.

rows.en: Yes. A single one can supply power to quite a few districts.
rows.notes: Corrected one large area to multiple districts; source geographic plurality retained.

rows.en: But then, if Gulfer attacks...
rows.notes: Source deliberately trails off on danger if Gulfer attacks.

rows.en: Then we'll have to rely on the Federation forces and the Nahel Argama team's other machines.
Above all, we can't let these blackouts shut down the essential services in each area.
Yes... Many facilities have their own generators, but if this continues, the chaos across Japan will go on.
Dr. Inoue, please arrange to send Hyper Dendoh Batteries to each region immediately.
Understood.
What!? The Hyper Dendoh Batteries!?
rows.notes: Ginga reacts to allocation of batteries; echo question retained.

rows.en: Yes, to supply power to the areas hit by blackouts. They started shipping them to each region yesterday.
I didn't know those batteries could hold that much power...
Yes. That's how Dendoh can generate so much power.
But if they take the batteries away, Dendoh won't be able to move! What do we do if Gulfer shows up!?
They're distributing the spare batteries we had stockpiled at GEAR headquarters.
And we have enough aboard the Cell Fighter for our immediate operations, so we'll manage.
But like Ginga said, if Gulfer attacks...
rows.notes: Hokuto repeats Ginga's concern and trails off before the alarm.
Wordless startled reaction retained.

rows.en: D-don't tell me... It's really happening!?
Are we under attack!?
Yes, it's a swarm of Gulfer Machine Beasts!
They're attacking the Shizuoka, Fukui, Akita, Okayama, Tokushima, Sapporo and Oita areas simultaneously!
rows.notes: All seven attacked regions preserved.

rows.en: O-over such a wide area...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate shocked fragment retained.

rows.en: Federation units in each region are currently engaging the Gulfer Machine Beasts!
Oh, wait! Could the areas they're attacking be...!?
rows.notes: Question trails off on inference; row213 identifies blackout areas.

rows.en: Yes, they match the areas hit by blackouts!
Hmm...! So was Gulfer behind the blackouts after all?
Then they'll reach Hoshimi Town eventually...!?
rows.notes: Restored enemy subject and coming attack from surrounding rows.

rows.en: No, they're already here! Another swarm of Gulfer Machine Beasts is approaching the Hoshimi Town area!
All hands to battle stations! Request a sortie from the Nahel Argama team!
Roger!
Heheheh, it looks like the operation's going nicely.
What is the situation in detail...?
According to Chip's report, Dendoh's batteries have already been shipped all over Japan.
rows.notes: Empty speaker resolved to Giga Absolute from source label and campaign_terms alias; Chip report retained.

rows.en: And Dendoh will use up the remaining batteries fighting the Machine Beasts we're sending in now.
And... without electricity, they can't recharge the batteries. So Dendoh will be unable to move after this battle.
An excellent plan, Diondra.
Hehehe... I'm honored by your praise.
I'd like to ask one thing, for reference. What is that thing secretly absorbing and compressing Japan's electricity?
Oh, that's something I used back on the previous planet... Fenomena.
rows.notes: Previous planet is not explicitly named; no identity added.

rows.en: It controls electricity and lightning... It can even knock an entire planet's axis out of alignment at will.
rows.notes: Diondra describes controlling Fenomena; actor for volition rendered as Diondra with uncertainty noted. Removed unsupported explicit I; at will retains volition without deciding controller versus machine.
uncertain: Source does not specify whether volition belongs to Diondra or Fenomena; at will keeps that controller ambiguity without adding a pronoun.

rows.en: ...I never knew they had such a superweapon.
rows.notes: Actual kind thought retained; they refers to Diondra/Gyandlar, not Gulfer.

rows.en: Well... It's about time I got ready to head down to Earth, too.
To put the finishing touches on the operation?
rows.notes: Empty speaker resolved to Giga Absolute; restored purpose question.

rows.en: That's right. Altair's already down there, so he'll have noticed what's going on by now anyway...
rows.notes: Altair already landed; male pronoun backed by glossary; source trails into motive row232.

rows.en: I'd hate to have him snatch the treasure away from me.
rows.notes: Treasure remains unspecified in this exchange.

rows.en: The Gulfer Machine Beasts have begun to retreat!
Dendoh is moving to pursue them!
No! Don't let them go! They've already used up batteries with their Final Attacks!
rows.notes: They refers to Dendoh's pilots; plural Final Attacks describes already-consumed batteries.

rows.en: At this rate, they'll use up the entire stock!
A report from a Federation radar site! They've spotted what appears to be Ogre near Point H9987!
rows.notes: Point identifier H9987 preserved; unit nickname Ogre follows glossary.

rows.en: What!? Where is it heading!?
Tokyo-3!
Tokyo-3...! Could it be heading for NERV Headquarters!?
rows.notes: Bright infers Ogre is heading for NERV; subject/action restored.

rows.en: Captain Bright, our Dendoh team will pursue Ogre to Tokyo-3!
rows.notes: Speaker and referents settled from original neighbors; full spoken meaning retained without compression.

rows.en: It's far too dangerous for you to go alone!
rows.notes: Speaker and referents settled from original neighbors; full spoken meaning retained without compression.

rows.en: Gulfer might attack again...!
rows.notes: Speaker and referents settled from original neighbors; full spoken meaning retained without compression.

rows.en: Captain, please have your forces keep watch over the Hoshimi Town area!
rows.notes: Vega asks Bright and his forces to guard Hoshimi; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
